papers.title: Predicted Paper 1: Core Focus
papers.description: Focuses on the highest-frequency CS core topics: process scheduling, database normalization, SQL, digital logic (K-maps), and general aptitude. Designed to mirror the most consistently tested areas across 2021-2025. Best for mid-level preparation assessment.

papers.description: Weighted heavily toward OS (memory management, synchronization), Computer Networks (transport and network layer), and Computer Organization (pipelining, cache). Digital Logic and Compiler Design are lighter. Good for students whose strengths lie in systems-level topics and hardware-software interaction.

papers.title: Predicted Paper 4: Emerging Topics & Integration
papers.description: Emphasizes emerging topics identified in the 2023-2025 trend: sophisticated K-maps, probabilistic reasoning, complex B+ tree operations, demand paging with LRU, and multi-table SQL. Theory of Computation focuses on PDA and CFG ambiguity. Higher proportion of hard and NAT questions. Best final practice paper before the actual exam.
